data.long_meaning: Iniya is a Sanskrit name derived from the Tamil language. It is believed to be the name of the Hindu goddess of love, Bhagavathy or Mariamman. Iniya represents the divine mother's love, compassion, and nurturing nature. The name is also associated with prosperity, happiness, and good fortune. The name Iniya carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Iniya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
